description: EstateBoost: whether the contract is on, how long a boost lasts, and for a crew its current boost (percent, until when, opted out) plus what a refresh would write now (Estate points, tier 0 to 4, percent). Pass homeIds (apartment ids the crew's owner holds, ascending) so apartments count; with wallet instead of crewId you get that wallet's Estate points and tier. Anyone can refresh a boost with prepare_estate_boost_refresh. Read only.

homeIds.description: Apartment ids the owner holds, strictly ascending (at most 40).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: get_estate_boost
